watson2024bounding gives a feasibility-filtered endpoint bootstrap, not the contact fourth-root law or random retained conditional kernel.
andrews2000boundary and fangSantos2019directional give general bootstrap-failure mechanisms, not the selected leaky-IV retained-resample kernel.
chernozhukovNeweySantos2023constrained and chernozhukovChetverikovKato2013gaussian provide relevant bootstrap tools, but not this contact/interior quadratic-score coupling.

romanoShaikh2010identifiedSet gives general uniform identified-set coverage; chernozhukovNeweySantos2023constrained gives constrained bootstrap inference, neither gives this one-rule fourth-root/root-n loss adaptation.
Standard regular LAN and delta-method reasoning; its role is to certify the project-specific comparison path.
hiranoPorter2012impossibility and takatsuKuchibhotla2024vanTrees supply general nonregular/minimax theory, not matched directed-Hausdorff leaky-IV contact and interior frontiers.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: oeq:uniform-multiplier-coupling and thm:adaptive-score-hull
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Uniform conditional multiplier approximation and uniform integrability are open; the score-hull coverage and expected-loss claims are conditional on their affirmative resolution.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The adaptive score-hull result is claimed conditionally on resolving oeq:uniform-multiplier-coupling; the contact-law, retained-kernel, and nonuniformity results remain unconditional.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 3694–3695, Section 3.3 and Theorem 4; p. 3706, Appendix A.7
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper discards infeasible bootstrap draws before endpoint quantiles in Theorem 4, and Appendix A.7 gives the p=2 quadratic leakage expression.

source_verification_receipts.version: Review of Economic Studies 86(1), version of record
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Under its Gaussian first-stage assumptions, standard-bootstrap consistency is equivalent to full Hadamard differentiability.
The paper establishes impossibility of locally asymptotically unbiased and alpha-quantile-unbiased estimation for nondifferentiable functionals.
The paper constructs random sets covering identified sets and provides conditions for pointwise and uniform asymptotic validity.
Uniform critical values are obtained by bootstrap approximation to a local parameter-space subset in constrained conditional-moment models.

source_verification_receipts.version: preprint corresponding to Annals of Statistics 41(6), 2786–2819
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives Gaussian and conditional Gaussian multiplier-bootstrap approximations for maxima of sums of high-dimensional random vectors.
The numerical-bootstrap paper treats constrained and unconstrained M-estimators at regular and nonstandard rates, including partially identified-model applications.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Statistical Planning and Inference 236, article 106245
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The method gives uniformly valid inference for root-n-consistent constrained optimization estimators at or drifting toward a boundary.
The paper analyzes first-stage correlations local to zero and motivates excluding weak-instrument regimes when ordinary fixed-relevance asymptotics are desired.
The paper develops minimax lower bounds for nonsmooth functionals and irregular statistical models.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Resolve the multiplier OEQ first through an explicit finite-dimensional coefficient-vector coupling, including a stated uniform-integrability bound for the score-band radius.

Add a formal separation proposition showing exactly why the contact sequence lies outside the root-n constrained-estimator regime of li2025proximal and outside the differentiability domain used by fangSantos2019directional.

State a practical corrected inferential output alongside the failure theorem: recommend the multiplier hull, with its computable endpoint extraction and implementation-level comparison to the retained-bootstrap quantiles.

recommended_next_step: Advance to Stage 0, prioritizing the Gaussian early-kill test and the uniform multiplier-coupling bottleneck.
